slices.focus: Volunteer-led standard visits run smoothly without Colleen's rescue, freeing her for teacher partnerships and program development.
slices.summary: In the fall rush, Colleen notices that the calmest days are the ones with a volunteer lead running the standard station sequence while she floats as a troubleshooter. The sequence (intro, apparatus stop, prevention station, hands-on piece) holds across multiple visits and leads. Freed from constant triage, she uses the time for in-person teacher follow-up, rebooking conversations, and new school contacts. She recognizes this as the program's maturation: 'tending the whole machine instead of physically pushing every gear.'
open_loops: One-page field note capturing stable-day pattern before it blurs in the rush
Reusable sentence naming the floating role for leadership context
Protect teacher-contact windows as delivery (not bonus extra)
decisions: Colleen's school program has matured to the point that volunteer-led standard visits often run without her direct rescue
